overall_quality.evidence: Microservices and monolithic architectures each have their own trade-offs. Microservices offer better scalability and flexibility, allowing for more efficient resource allocation and easier maintenance. However, they can be more complex to manage and require more robust infrastructure. Monolithic architectures, on the other hand, are simpler to develop and maintain, but they can be less scalable and may require more resources to handle increased load.
